headline: A {{multiplayer mod}} for Metal Gear Solid V, for up to {{16 players}}
summary: Joint Operations brings the game's online functionality into the single-player world. One player hosts, up to fifteen others join, and everyone shares the same open world and missions.
how: The host's game runs the mission, the AI and the world. It is the single source of truth, so every player sees the same outcome.
Each other player controls their own soldier and camera, and sends their movement and actions to the host.
Players connect through Steam's relay network, with a direct connection as fallback. No ports to open and no Konami servers involved.

host.text: The host takes {{Venom Snake's place}}. Wherever the game puts Snake, the host is there:
